description: Verifies the perihelion advance of a Mercury-like orbit (a = 1000 r_s, e = 0.20563) integrated for one hundred revolutions with the sixth-order Gauss-Legendre scheme: the accumulated precession matches the exact elliptic-integral result of the Schwarzschild geodesic within a relative 1e-8.
